name: cutcod-promo-film
description: CutCod 58-second product promo, rendered from code: the real cutcod.com pages driven in a headless browser + GSAP timeline + code-synthesized score.

scripts.plan: node tools/py.mjs tools/make_plan.py && node tools/py.mjs tools/cues.py
scripts.film: npm run mix && npm run build && npm run render
scripts.check: node tools/py.mjs tools/check_delivery.py plan.json --video renders/cutcod-promo.mp4 --mix-report evidence/audio-mix.json
